title: AW Helping Baby Turtle - Day 7 Collecting Stones Meditation Journey
text: foreign [Music] of the collecting Stones meditation Journey I've already thrown my stones in earlier today and but I found a stranded turtle on the road and it was drying up and it had nowhere to go and I've been Reviving it today before I got a chance to take it to a pond and so I've been giving it a little chance I've been keeping it out of the Heat and Sun giving it a little bit of water some grass and vegetation and then now I'm ready to let this little baby turtle go it's a mud turtle so they don't get really big but this is a very small turtle I don't think they grow more than a few inches past this foreign [Music] [Music] foreign [Music]
